# arin_irr_route (Resource)

An IRR route or route6 object. Routes maintained by ARIN for auto_link ROAs are
refused; manage those through the ROA instead.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `descriptions` (List of String) descr lines.
- `origin_as` (Number) Origin AS number. ARIN forbids changing it in place.
- `prefix` (String) CIDR prefix, either address family.

### Optional

- `remarks` (List of String) Remarks lines.

### Read-Only

- `admin_pocs` (Set of String) Admin POC handles. System generated by ARIN from
  the org.
- `auto_linked_roa_handle` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `ip_version` (Number)
- `last_modified` (String)
- `member_of` (Set of String) Route-set names referencing this route. Server
  derived.
- `net_handle` (String)
- `org_handle` (String)
- `routing_pocs` (Set of String) Routing POC handles. System generated by ARIN
  from the org.
- `tech_pocs` (Set of String) Tech POC handles. System generated by ARIN from
  the org.
